verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents an official remote MCP server. Any MCP client can point at it to call 10,000+ pre-built connected-app tools across 3,000+ APIs, with per-user auth handled automatically. That directly delivers the 'connected app actions as MCP tools' branch of the story, and the probe and llms.txt confirm the MCP server offering. Missing for 10: evidence that a user's own custom workflows can be exposed as MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of external agents calling the server.
